title: Strawberries in plastic tunnel: 126 / 18 / 18 kg of polyethylene disposal per kg of fruit
observation: 126.22 / 18.085 / 18.079 kg `Disposal, polyethylene, 0.4% water, to municipal incineration` per kg fruit, against 0.0096 / 0.042 / 0.036 kg of polyethylene granulate entering; the tunnel film is already disposed of in the tunnel dataset (per m²·a). The LCIA workbook scores them at 383 / 55 / 55 kg CO₂-eq per kg; the heated greenhouse in the same group scores 2.6. Identical in both releases; not in the 2026 change log.
method: Re-measured on the release files by the reporter's side, not by a second person; the patch stops if a dataset does not carry the expected amount.

answer.summary: BAFU confirmed the error and gave corrected amounts. They equal each dataset's own polyethylene granulate input. BAFU said it will correct the datasets in its next release.

next.action: Verify the corrected amounts in the next BAFU release; then record the correction and retire patch 0001.

retained.text: An earlier mass-balance framing of the finding was wrong and was corrected.
